parameters.name: IsItemStatistic
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to return the statistics of the check items, including the number of check items supported by the system and the number of check items available to you. Default value: **false**. Valid values:

*   **true**
*   **false**

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: ResourceDirectoryAccountId
parameters.description:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member in the resource directory.

>  You can call the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to query the IDs of Alibaba Cloud accounts.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas get-check-summary --lang zh --resource-directory-account-id 000 --vendors ALIYUN --is-item-statistic false --task-sources YAO_CHI --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas GetCheckSummary --region cn-hangzhou --IsItemStatistic false --TaskSources.1 YAO_CHI --Vendors.1 ALIYUN --ResourceDirectoryAccountId 000 --Lang zh
